LanguageData.RR_Start_Welcome:
Your Async Industries branch is operational. The gate is still incomplete.
Use Operations to review your staff, materials, branch account and first survey. Your company allocation is an account balance; receiving holds your physical supplies.
Finish the gate, assign a capable operator, calibrate it, and prepare the return route before you dispatch a crew.
Native Work, Research, Architect and pawn controls all remain available.
LanguageData.RR_Start_Failed: The company could not finish startup: {0}\n\nExisting people, buildings, and stock have been retained. Repeating startup will not issue another physical allocation. If headquarters construction is incomplete, retain the log and return to scenario setup. If only branch registration failed, correct the reported condition and use the explicit registration recovery when available.
LanguageData.RR_Start_MissingSetup: A completed Async Industries headquarters receipt was not found.
LanguageData.RR_Start_PhysicalSetupFailed: Headquarters placement stopped before all starting stock and furnishings were placed.
LanguageData.RR_Start_RosterCount: This start requires five distinct staff, one for each initial company role.
LanguageData.RR_Start_RosterCapability: The {0} must be able to move and manipulate, perform the role's starting work, and meet its skill requirements. Reroll or adjust this staff member before continuing.
LanguageData.RR_Event_SoloGroupOpening: The group started inside, and the way out was already there. Nobody built it and nobody knows who did.
LanguageData.RR_Hint_Contact: Somebody needs to be told about this. Not for help, necessarily. Just so it is written down somewhere that is not in here.
LanguageData.RR_Hint_Surface: Open sky. Nobody is going to believe a word of it, and there is nothing standing here that we did not walk out of.
LanguageData.RR_Hint_Comms: The radio works. Whether anyone on the other end has a category for what we would be reporting is a separate question.
LanguageData.RR_Hint_DoorsRunOut: The doors stop going anywhere new around here. Whatever is further in, nobody is going to walk to it.
